newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-RUSSIA DROPS BESCHASTNYKH FOR CYPRUS GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RUSSIA DROPS BESCHASTNYKH FOR CYPRUS GAME.

text.p: Russian coach Boris Ignatyev has dropped Vladimir Beschastnykh of Spanish club Racing Santander for next week's World Cup qualifier against Cyprus.
"He's not in good fighting form," squad spokesman Yuri Yudin said on Thursday. "We're going to Cyprus to win."
Sporting Gijon's Yuri Nikiforov, suspended after being sent off in the previous group five game in Luxembourg, and injured Spartak Moscow winger Andrei Tikhonov will also miss the game on March 29.
Tikhonov, Russia's 1996 Player of the Year, is nursing a muscle strain and will be out for around a fortnight.
Spartak captain and playmaker Ilya Tsymbalar is named in the squad but there is also a question mark over his fitness.
Bestchastnykh was in form for Russia last year, netting most recently in their 4-0 win over Cyprus in Moscow last September and in their 4-0 defeat of Luxembourg.
Ignatyev, facing a Cypriot side boosted by their shock 2-0 win over Israel, has preferred Bologna's Igor Kolyvanov and Reggiana's Igor Simutenkov up front.
Goalkeepers - Stanislav Cherchesov (Tirol Innsbruck), Sergei Ovchinnikov (Lokomotiv Moscow).

Defenders - Ramiz Mamedov (Spartak Moscow), Dmitry Khlestov (Spartak Moscow), Omar Tetradze (Roma), Igor Chugaynov (Lokomotiv Moscow), Maxim Bokov (CSKA Moscow), Dmitry Popov (Compostela), Viktor Onopko (Oviedo).

Midfielders - Igor Yanovsky (Alania), Andrei Kanchelskis (Fiorentina), Dmitry Alenichev (Spartak Moscow), Ilya Tsymbalar (Spartak Moscow), Alexander Mostovoy (Celta Vigo), Valery Karpin (Valencia), Yevgeny Kharlachev (Lokomotiv Moscow).
Forwards - Igor Kolyvanov (Bologna), Igor Simutenkov (Reggiana), Anatoly Kanishchev (Alania Vladikavkaz), Alexei Gerasimenko (Rostselmash Rostov).
